description: Structural Determinants of Power System Congestion is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Arash Beiranvand, Paul Cuffe. Line outage security constraints ensure that a proposed generating schedule will not load any line to the point where its removal causes more overloading elsewhere. These security constraints increase operating costs by occasionally precluding the usage of the cheapest generation sources. That is, power networks frequently suffer congestion in this (𝑁 − 1) sense. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 8815122 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
